ailshara_1.m: Psst, hey. Interested in doing some trading? I am always looking for acquiring ... well, items of others...
r: Sure, let me see what you have.

ailshara_2.m: Oh yes. You see, these Feygard patrol guards carry some really interesting things. They don't seem to care much if some of their shipments ... well, disappear.
r: OK, let me see what you have.
I should really not get involved in this. Goodbye.

ailshara_completed_n_1.m: Sigh, it's you. What do you want?
r: Let me see what you have to trade.

ailshara_completed_y_1.m: Hello again my Shadow friend. How may I help you?
r: Let me see what you have to trade.

ailshara_deliver_1.m: Hello again. Did you deliver those items to the smith in Vilegard?
r: Never mind that, let me see what you have to trade.
No. I will help Feygard instead.
Can you tell me again what I was supposed to do?

ailshara_deliver_2.m: Good. You should also try to convince Gandoren into thinking that you helped him.

ailshara_deliver_3.m: Excellent! You do indeed walk with the Shadow my friend. I am glad to hear that there are at least a few decent folk still around.

ailshara_delivered_1.m: Your help will be most appreciated by the people of Nor City, and you will be welcome among us.

ailshara_fg_1.m: By the Shadow, you sound like one of those deceptive snobs from Feygard.

ailshara_fg_2.m: Shadow help you, child. You should question yourself whether you really are making the right choice here.

ailshara_interested_1.m: Psst, hey you! I saw you talking to Gandoren over there, and I happened to notice that you exchanged some items. Anything interesting?
r: Never mind that, let me see what you have to trade.
I better not talk about it.
Gandoren specifically asked me not to talk to you about it.
Yes, Gandoren wants me to deliver some equipment for Feygard. Do you want a part of the deal?

ailshara_interested_2.m: Hah, of course. Gandoren would not like it if I were to get a glimpse into his business. I assume you are helping him deliver those items somewhere. Tell me this, what did he promise you in return? Gold? Honor? No?
r: Now that you mention it, he didn't actually say there would be a reward.
I am doing this for the glory of Feygard.
Helping Feygard seems like the right thing to do.

ailshara_interested_3.m: As usual, Feygard keeps all its riches to itself. What if I were to tell you there was a way for you to gain from all this as well?
r: I have no problem helping Feygard without any personal gain.
I better not get involved in this, goodbye.

ailshara_interested_4.m: Let me tell you my plan. As you might know, everyone believes there will be some coming conflict between the deceptive snobs of Feygard and the glorious people of Nor City.

ailshara_interested_5.m: Any help we can bring to Nor City in this matter is welcome. These items that Gandoren gave you would be useful to our people in the southern lands.

ailshara_interested_6.m: These items, if you were to deliver them to our allies down in Vilegard, then the Shadow would look favorably upon you.

ailshara_interested_7.m: This way, the people could get back some piece of the riches that Feygard has stolen from all of us.

ailshara_interested_8.m: If you indeed are walking in the Shadow, then deliver these items to the smith in Vilegard. He will be able to make good use of them. He might also have some other task for you.
r: I will see what I can do.
No. I will help Feygard instead.
Whatever, I choose my own path.

ailshara_interested_9.m: Shadow be with you. May the Shadow guide you on the clouded paths that you walk.

feygard_shipment.10: I met Gandoren, the guard captain at the Crossroads guardhouse. He told me about some trouble up in Loneford, that have forced the guards to be even more alert than usual. Because of this, they can't do their regular errands themselves but need help with some basic things.
feygard_shipment.20: Gandoren wants me to help him transport a shipment of 10 iron swords to another guard post to the south.
feygard_shipment.21: I have agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment, as a service for Feygard.
feygard_shipment.22: I have grudgingly agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment.
feygard_shipment.25: I should deliver the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern.
feygard_shipment.26: Gandoren tells me that Ailshara has expressed some interest in the Feygard shipments, and urges me to stay away from her.
feygard_shipment.30: Ailshara is indeed interested in the shipment, and wants me to help Nor City with the supplies instead.
feygard_shipment.35: If I want to help Ailshara and Nor City, I should deliver the shipment to the smith in Vilegard instead.
feygard_shipment.50: I have delivered the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.55: I have delivered the shipment to the smith in Vilegard.
feygard_shipment.56: The Vilegard smith gave me a shipment of degraded items that I should deliver to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern instead of the normal ones.
feygard_shipment.60: I have delivered the shipment of degraded items to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.80: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment.
feygard_shipment.81: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment. He never suspected anything. I should also report back to Ailshara.
feygard_shipment.82: I have reported back to Ailshara.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
